protocol.authorship: Authored and frozen before any sprint candidate generation. No HumanEval or repository-task questions or observed outputs used. Synthetic development screen; possible training overlap unknown.
protocol.selection: At most one promotion: material task-level quality or total generation-time improvement vs MXFP4, near 7.5 decimal GB. A 1-2 task difference alone is insufficient; report paired differences and runtime variability. No promotion if evidence is weak.
protocol.fixture_validation: Syntax compiled; escaped-backslash input corrected before any sprint generation. No model outputs inspected.

memory.scope: MLX allocator peak, including load; excludes system/GPU driver memory
